# netbox_cluster_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/virtualization/#cluster-groups):

> Cluster groups may be created for the purpose of organizing clusters. The arrangement of clusters into groups is optional.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cluster_group" "dc_west" {
  description = "West Datacenter Cluster"
  name        = "dc-west"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the cluster group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the cluster group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the cluster group.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the cluster group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the cluster group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_cluster_group.example 1
```
